LEARNING BECOMES EXPERIENCE

Experience built through purposeful work.

Participants connect enterprise workflows with documentation, testing and delivery expectations. The focus is understanding the task, the business purpose and the standard of work expected.

Connecting Odoo knowledge
with business experience.
01

Follow business processes

Explore how sales, purchasing, inventory, finance and projects depend on one another.

02

Work with Odoo

Use approved environments and relate user actions and configuration to real business flows.

03

Document, test and improve

Prepare scenarios, reproduce issues, verify corrections and communicate useful evidence.

04

Build professional character

Practice ownership, dependable follow-through, collaboration and early communication of blockers.
